model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of different language models across three different categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The accuracy values range from the mid-50s to the low 60s. The MMLU category consistently shows the highest accuracy for the DAPO(+Self-reflection) model, while the PGRO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO models exhibit varying levels of performance across the categories. In the Mathverse category, the PGRO model appears to have the lowest accuracy, whereas in the Physics category, the PRPO model outperforms the others. No specific grouping or sequential arrangement of the models is evident, and each model's performance is distinct within its respective category.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The bar chart compares the accuracy of different datasets across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, measured in percentage terms. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, with values ranging from 50% to 62%. The horizontal axis lists the three categories.

There are five groups of bars, each representing a combination of a dataset and the method of self-reflection it uses, specifically DAPO, PPO, GRPO, and SRPO. Each group's bars are color-coded, with DAPO in blue striped, DAPO in green diagonal stripes, GRPO in orange diagonal stripes, SRPO in red horizontal stripes, PPO in blue diagonal stripes, and PPO in green vertical stripes. 

In the Mathverse category, the accuracy percentages for the different combinations are as follows: DAPO+Self-reflection is just over 50%, DAPO without self-reflection is around 52%, GRPO is slightly below 60%, SRPO is the lowest at just above 50%, PPO+Self-reflection is just below 56%, and PPO without self-reflection is around 54%.

In the MMLU category, the accuracy percentages are higher compared to Mathverse. DAPO+Self-reflection is about 56%, DAPO without self-reflection is just below 58%, GRPO is around 60%, SRPO is just above 56%, PPO+Self-reflection is slightly above 58%, and PPO without self-reflection is just below 58%.

In the Physics category, the highest accuracy is observed in DAPO+Self-reflection, which is around 61%. DAPO without self-reflection is just above 58%, GRPO is just below 61%, SRPO is around 59%, PPO+Self-reflection is just above 58%, and PPO without self-reflection is slightly below 58%.

The accuracy percentages for all combinations show an apparent general trend that the addition of self-reflection to the DAPO dataset tends to increase the accuracy across all three categories. There is also a noticeable variation in accuracy within the homozygous dataset types.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy percentage of different groups in Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics exams. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% in increments of 2%. The horizontal axis lists the three subjects: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each subject has four groups: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, and PPO, each differentiated by unique colors and patterns. For Mathverse, the DAPO+Self-reflection group has an accuracy of approximately 60%, the DAPO group around 58%, the GRPO group approximately 56%, and the PPO group around 54%. In MMLU, the DAPO+Self-reflection group is slightly lower at around 57%, DAPO at approximately 55%, GRPO around 54%, and PPO approximately 52%. For Physics, the group's accuracy is around 59% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58% for DAPO, 57% for GRPO, and PPO around 56%. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis or annotations other than the distinct colors and patterns to distinguish between the groups.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm visualisiert den Prozentsatz der Genauigkeit für drei verschiedene Lehrsysteme—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO ohne Reflektion, PRPO und PPO—betrachtet mit zwei Lehrveranstaltungen—Mathverse und MMLU, in der Kategorie Physik. Die horizontale Achse enthält die Lehrveranstaltung, die vertikale Achse zeigt den gerankten Wert der Genauigkeit (%), wobei der Wert für die Prozentarberechnung abstimmt. Die Kategorien werden dargestellt durch farbige Balken mit unterschiedlichen Mustern, wobei DAPO+Self-reflection in verticale Streifen dargestellt wird, DAPO ohne in vereinheitlichtsten Balken, PRPO in schrägen Balken und PPO in vertikalen Balken. Die Verteilung zeigt signifikante Unterschiede in der Genauigkeit, wobei das SPRPO bei Mathverse bemerkenswert niedriger bei 54% ist, während im Vergleich alle anderen Systeme im Bereich von 54% bis 62% liegen. Die Genauigkeit für Physik ist konsistent höher für alle Systeme, wobei PRPO+Self-reflection und PRPO die höchsten Werte mit jeweils über 60% erreichen und DAPO das niedrigste mit etwas über 54%.
